entry.title: HexChord 73 1.0.0
entry.summary: HexChord 73: stereo chord synthesizer with four engines, eight chords and four voicings. Tested on MPC Live 2 Retro / Gen1 / MPC OS 3.9.1 and 3.10. CPU: **WARN** — start with one or two instances and check the project CPU meter. [Installation and controls](https://github.com/Eurikon/mpc-vst-plugins/blob/main/Instruments/HexaChord-73/README.md).
